title: A CODE tag whose note is a documentation URL passes kb-verify lint, because code_pointer now accepts scheme-less URLs as pointers
goal: kb-verify lint.py (.claude/skills/kb-verify/lint.py) requires a CODE pointer's path to match the pinned path suffix of its source row, as kbingest drift does, so a CODE tag whose note is a docs URL (learn.microsoft.com/en-us/x#y, github.com/o/r/x.py#sym, raw.githubusercontent.com/...) fails lint, while a valid path such as Contoso.Web.App/Program.cs#Main still passes; a test named lint_code_pointer_matches_source_path plants both. Found by the SP-7irdeeel review (D1 of BG-zxe2gkbb).
repro_reason: the gap is a lint rule; the text match shows lint does not compare the pointer path with the source row's pinned path
